Use same framing, object positions, ground scale, door and bench sizes and 2:1 camera in ALL four panels.

TOP LEFT BAIRRO: cream plaster kite workshop with navy door, terracotta roof, large flat green canopy, light sidewalk and blue-gray asphalt. Handmade kites and bamboo ribs, one folded paper bird and spool display, a little cyan/coral diamond mural.

Quiet readable paths. Only original symbols and designs.
